sw.method: NFKC casefold whitespace normalized equality and bidirectional full-passage containment; train uses full SIB text containment. No fuzzy/semantic dedup or post-test filtering.
sw.id_audit: SIB official index_id is retained; Belebele exposes source URL, question number and passage but no canonical FLORES integer ID. No unverified ID correspondence asserted.
sw.limitations: Exact/containment checks do not exclude paraphrases, partial fragments or pretraining exposure. No test rows removed or tuned.
